info.summary: Sleep, recovery and movement from your Apple Health export, with a weekly AI report
Schlaf, Erholung und Bewegung aus dem Apple-Health-Export, mit KI-Wochenbericht
Sonno, recupero e movimento dall’esportazione di Apple Salute, con report settimanale IA
info.description:
Health Check turns the weekly Apple Health export of your phone (also data from smart watches that write to Apple Health) into a private dashboard inside Nextcloud.
* Drop Export.zip into /Health/Import: a background job imports it with a streaming XML parser (the export can be close to 1 GB) * One row per day: steps, distance, active energy, heart rate, resting heart rate, SpO2, VO2max, weight, body fat, sleep stages * Three transparent rings (sleep, recovery, movement), trend charts, infographic for week, month and year * Neutral early hints compared with your own 28-day baseline, never diagnoses * Doctor report (print or PDF) for 30 or 90 days * Goals with adaptive weekly targets, streaks and a weekly plan from the AI (via a signed webhook to an automation such as n8n) * "Ask your data" chat on aggregates only (optional, needs an OpenAI-compatible endpoint) * Workouts in a private calendar, dashboard widget, installable web app
Data stays per user. Administrators cannot see other people's data in the app.
